summary: Attack cases (a) and (c) hold: all seven tutor-commission K files are unchanged in the phase range, and no e2e file is counted. The D4 deletion does not match its class row, and gate-0d705612.json records two deletions that still run at HEAD. Both new fixtures hold against hostile probes. ADV-1 routes to Green.
blocking_findings: ADV-1 [Blocker] adversarial: D4 commit 0d705612d deleted only 1 of the 3 classified navigation cases, and gate-0d705612.json lists cases as deleted that still run. classification.md row D4 names 'returns the active locale x3' in src/locales/navigation.test.tsx. The commit changed it.each(['en','th','zh']) to it.each(['th','zh']), so 'returns the active th locale' and 'returns the active zh locale' still exist and pass at HEAD (vitest list confirms 3 nav cases). gate-0d705612.json deleted_case_names lists all three locale cases plus claims deleted_cases=6 with cases_after=3140, but the static diff c1410ed97..0d705612d removes only 4 cases (navigation 1, real-logos-captures.red 2, primary-page-images 1), and neither green log shows a skip. The deletion set does not match the class rows (test-strategy.md Phase 2 Green gate item 3), and the gate record is false. Route-to-Green: delete the two remaining classified nav cases, or get PM approval to keep them and amend the classification row and the gate record.
nonblocking_findings: ADV-2 [Nit] adversarial: no coverage log carries a literal line_coverage_pct= label line. The label lives in the gate JSON files, and each log holds the istanbul 'Lines : NN.NN%' summary. Every gate value matches its log summary (spot-checked 407c5d9: 90.03), so the A3 defense holds in substance.

vitest list at HEAD shows src/locales/navigation.test.tsx still runs 'returns the active th locale' and 'returns the active zh locale'.
git show 0d705612d --stat shows 3 files and 22 deletions; the navigation hunk only drops 'en' from the it.each array.
green-e332f594.log reports 3146 passed; green-0d705612.log reports 3140 passed; neither log contains a skip line.
grep -c line_coverage_pct over all coverage-*.log files returns 0; tail of coverage-407c5d9.log shows 'Lines : 90.03%', equal to gate-407c5d9.json line_coverage_pct.
baseline.json line_coverage_pct=86.52 and every gate floor is 85.52, the baseline minus 1 point; every gate line_coverage_pct is 89.86 to 90.94.
green-at-7008ccef.log reports 89 files and 3081 tests passed, matching gate-7008ccef.json cases_after=3081 (F10 remediation holds).
per-file-counts.md contains no e2e row, and classification.md lists all six e2e files as not counted.
Both fixture probes pass: 10 of 10 in locale-key-check.adversarial.test.ts and real-css.adversarial.test.ts at commit bfda22bd8.
The phase-range diff under apps/ names test files and test fixtures only; no production file changed.
